blocks.text: CEBU CITY — Detdet Pepito once watched her volleyball idols and older sisters, Marge and MJ, play for San Sebastian in the Shakey’s V-League, the predecessor to the Premier Volleyball League. On Saturday, the Capital1 rookie gets her own moment in the spotlight as she begins her professional career in the league that grew from those beginnings, with the PVL’s 10th anniversary kicking off with the All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series before an expected sold-out crowd at SM Seaside Cebu Arena. “I’m really grateful because I used to just watch them play, and now I get to play alongside them.
